validity.value: A recent photograph, not older than 1 month, in accordance with international standards as set out in ICAO Document 9303, Part 1, 6th edition.

cross_verification.note_en: Kosovo Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora (mfa-ks.net, archived English page) 'Visa application procedure' explicitly requires the photo to follow ICAO Document 9303 Part 1 (6th edition) and be no older than 1 month. The page cites the ICAO standard by name/edition rather than restating specific numeric values (e.g. mm size, background colour) in its own text, so size/background/head_height are left unverified rather than inferring the generic ICAO 35×45mm figure on Kosovo's behalf. DB's size (3.5×4.5cm) and head_height (3.2~3.6cm) are plausible under ICAO 9303 but were not independently restated by this Kosovo government source, so no db_conflicts entry is warranted (absence of confirmation, not contradiction).
